summary: All five requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-5) appear to be substantially implemented in the diff. REQ-1 is addressed via backend/main.mo Katha model fixes and frontend form corrections. REQ-2 is addressed via MP3 upload in AdminPanel.tsx, ExternalBlob handling, and the audioBlob field in the Katha type. REQ-3 is addressed via the AudioPlayer component in KathaDetail.tsx with play/pause and conditional rendering. REQ-4 is addressed via Community.tsx auth guard and feed layout. REQ-5 is addressed via the revamped useSpeechNarration.ts hook with voice loading, visibility API handling, and retry logic. One notable gap is the backend addKatha/updateKatha function signature in main.mo being truncated, making it impossible to fully verify REQ-1 and REQ-2 backend acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: The backend addKatha function should correctly accept and persist all required fields without throwing errors; Motoko actor katha creation logic handles all field types properly.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and the actual addKatha function body is not visible. We cannot confirm the Motoko function signature and persistence logic are fully correct, though the Katha type definition with audioBlob is visible.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration.mo module was added with OldActor/NewActor types and a run() migration function.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not request a migration module. It only required adding the audioBlob field to the Katha model and fixing the addKatha function. A separate migration.mo file was not requested.
